subject: planner: fix list partition with non point range locates to a wrong partition (#57072)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent, focusing on list-partition pruning behavior. The planner-side list pruner now treats `ranger.Range` full-scan ranges as non-prunable (`r.IsFullRange(false)` => full partition set), and table-side list range location now handles NULL bounds explicitly to avoid incorrect key-range mapping (especially avoiding NULL->0 causing missed negative list values) while still being conservative. Checked upstream/master: the key changes remain present (moved planner file path), with no later follow-up indicating a reverted/buggy fix.
